notes.content:
[b]Mutant Alley - VR Support DLC now available![/b]

Supported Headsets:

[list]
[*] HTC Vive
[*] Valve Index
[*] Oculus Rift / S
[*] Oculus Quest 1/2 (Via Link)
[/list]
